notes:
Settings and Home Search now use standard Google Material tabs, switches, dropdowns, fields and buttons.
Normal video decoding: Auto / HW / SW. Compatibility: Auto / HW / HW+ / SW. HW+ requests forced hardware/direct rendering with VLC fallback. Normal changes apply when reopening a channel; the compatibility in-player chooser reconnects immediately.
Play in background and Picture-in-picture have separate actions/options. Background defaults off. If both automatic options are on, PiP takes priority; explicit Play in background skips PiP for that departure.
Removed Guide Date & time and Now controls, including overflow versions. Current/next listings, full schedules and reminders remain.
Multiple playlists are planned for later, not included in this update.
